newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Health 1996 net profit up 73.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: Health 1996 net profit up 73.77 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.25 yuan vs 0.18 yuan
Net assets per share 2.23 yuan vs 2.59 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Health Mineral Water Co Ltd.
Note: The results, under Chinese accounting standards, were published in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday.
Based on international accounting standards, the company's net profit was 33.97 million yuan in 1996 and 22.57 million in 1995.
Shenzhen Health's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.118 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 9.
